STAR.name: STAR
STAR.description: Set the scene, state your responsibility, describe what you did, and finish with a measurable outcome.

PREP.name: PREP
PREP.description: Lead with your answer, justify it, back it with a concrete example, then restate it.

EXPLAIN.name: Explain simply
EXPLAIN.description: Start with the one-sentence idea, walk through the mechanism, ground it in an example, and close with the takeaway.

SPEECH.name: Speech structure
SPEECH.description: Hook the audience, make one clear point, support it, and end with a memorable close.

categories.label: Behavioral
questions: Tell me about a time you faced a conflict in a team and how you handled it.
Describe a difficult problem you solved. What was your approach?
Tell me about a time you failed. What did you learn?
Give an example of a goal you set and how you achieved it.
Tell me about a time you showed leadership without being the official leader.
Describe a situation where you had to learn something new very quickly.
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a decision. What did you do?
Describe a time you worked under pressure or a tight deadline.
Tell me about a project you are proud of and your role in it.
Describe a time you received critical feedback and how you responded.

categories.label: Explain it simply
questions: Explain how a machine learning model learns, as if to a non-technical manager.
